changeProfile.title: How do I change my profile details?
changeProfile.content:
Open the Profile tab and tap "Edit profile," in the Account section.

There you can update your name and profile photo. Tap save to confirm the changes.

resetPassword.title: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.content:
If you haven't signed in yet, tap "Forgot password" on the login screen. We'll send a reset link to your registered email.

If you're already signed in, go to Profile, Settings and Security, then tap "Change password." This option only appears for accounts created with email and password.

manageSubscription.title: How do I manage my subscription?
manageSubscription.content:
Open the Profile tab, go to Settings, and tap "Account" in the Privacy & data section. Then tap "Subscription" to see your plan status.

On the Subscription screen, tap the top card containing your plan information to open subscription management in the App Store or Google Play — that's where you change or cancel your plan, since AJ Fit doesn't process payments directly.

assessmentEstimate.title: Is body fat percentage a diagnosis?
assessmentEstimate.content:
No. The calculated body fat percentage is an estimate for tracking your progress over time, based on the measurements you provide.

It doesn't replace a clinical assessment. For diagnosis or medical guidance, see a health professional.

changeWorkout.title: Can I replace an exercise?
changeWorkout.content:
During a workout, tap the swap icon next to an exercise to open the substitution options. The alternatives shown preserve the same muscle group.

You can choose to replace it just this once or for the whole workout.

changeLanguage.title: How do I change the app language?
changeLanguage.content:
Open the Profile tab, tap Settings, then Language.

Choose Português, English or Español — the change applies immediately, no restart needed.

appNotLoading.title: The app won't load. What should I do?
appNotLoading.content:
Check your internet connection and fully close the app before opening it again.

Also check if there's an update available in the app store. If it keeps happening, report what happened so our team can investigate.

contactSupport.title: How do I contact support?
contactSupport.content:
You can report a problem or send a suggestion anytime from your profile Settings.

You can also open a ticket directly from the Help Center, under "Talk to support," or at the end of any article that didn't solve your issue.
